insider_note: The significance is one sentence and it is a big claim: the oxygen in the air we breathe comes from here. Write it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Where it occurs
steps.margin_note: Region plus which reaction. Three lines.
lines: Photolysis of water occurs in the GRANA of the
It happens during the light reaction.
steps.why: Splitting water needs light energy, so it happens where the light-absorbing membranes are.
common_mistakes: Saying photolysis happens in the stroma. It happens in the GRANA.
Saying it happens during the dark reaction. It is part of the LIGHT reaction.
steps.memory_tip: Water is split where the light is caught.

steps.label: Significance
steps.margin_note: Oxygen, the atmosphere, and what else the split supplies. Four lines.

lines.text: The source of the oxygen in the atmosphere

lines: This is the main source of atmospheric oxygen.
The reaction also supplies electrons and protons
steps.why: Splitting water releases oxygen as a by-product, and because plants do this on an enormous scale it is where nearly all the oxygen in the air came from.
common_mistakes: Saying the oxygen comes from carbon dioxide. It comes from WATER.
Giving only 'oxygen is released'. The significance is that it is the atmosphere's source.
steps.memory_tip: The oxygen we breathe was once water in a leaf.
